description: This file contains test cases for functions related to redacting sensitive URL information, including redaction of query parameters, handling URL-like strings, and identifying sensitive URL configuration paths and tags.

methods.name: redactSensitiveUrl
methods.description: Redacts userinfo and sensitive query parameters in URLs, replacing them with asterisks.

methods.name: redactSensitiveUrlLikeString
methods.description: Redacts userinfo in strings that resemble URLs, even if they are not valid URLs.

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlQueryParamName
methods.description: Determines if a query parameter name is considered sensitive.

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlConfigPath
methods.description: Checks if a configuration path may embed URL secrets.

methods.name: hasSensitiveUrlHintTag
methods.description: Checks if an object has the url-secret hint tag.
